devdoc.details: This contract holds tokens that anyone with a voucher signed by the authority can redeem. The contract validates if the voucher presented is valid and then sends tokens to the Staking contract by calling the collect() function passing the voucher allocationID. The contract enforces that only one voucher for an allocationID can be redeemed. Only governance can change the authority.

approveAll().details: Increased gas efficiency instead of approving on each voucher redeem

params._authority: Account that can sign the vouchers that this contract will redeem
params._governor: Account capable of withdrawing funds and setting the authority
params._staking: Address of the protocol Staking contract

redeem((address,uint256,bytes)).details: The voucher must be signed using an Ethereum signed message

redeemMany((address,uint256,bytes)[]).details: Each voucher must be signed using an Ethereum signed message

setAuthority(address,bool).details: Only the governor can set the authority

params._authorized: True if the authority is authorized to sign vouchers, false to unset

devdoc.title: Allocation Exchange

NewOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has accepted their role

NewPendingOwnership(address,address).notice: Emitted when a new owner/governor has been set, but is pending acceptance

acceptOwnership().notice: Admin function for pending governor to accept role and update governor. This function must called by the pending governor.

approveAll().notice: Approve the staking contract to pull any amount of tokens from this contract.

redeem((address,uint256,bytes)).notice: Redeem a voucher signed by the authority. No voucher double spending is allowed.

setAuthority(address,bool).notice: Set the authority allowed to sign vouchers.
